name: Weekly Dev Summary with Claude API

nodes.name: Process & Build Prompt
nodes.notes: Formats data and builds the Claude API prompt

nodes.name: Claude API Call

nodes.name: Route Delivery
nodes.notes: Routes to email or webhook based on DELIVERY_METHOD variable
